package diagnosticbinding

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

const testCourseID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

func testCreatedAt() time.Time {
	return time.Date(2026, 9, 26, 12, 0, 0, 123000000, time.UTC)
}

func TestCanonicalBindingBuildsClosedV2SpecAndDigest(t *testing.T) {
	binding, err := CanonicalBinding(testCourseID, testCreatedAt())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("canonical binding: %v", err)
	}
	if binding.GoalCode != CanonicalGoal || binding.DirectionCode != CanonicalDirection || binding.BindingRevision != CanonicalRevision || binding.PolicyVersion != domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1 || !binding.Active || binding.CreatedAt != testCreatedAt() {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected canonical binding: %#v", binding)
	}
	if binding.BindingDigest == "" {
		t.Fatal("canonical binding must calculate its digest")
	}
}

func TestCanonicalBindingRejectsNonCanonicalCourseOrTime(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := CanonicalBinding("11111111-1111-4111-8111-11111111111A", testCreatedAt()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected canonical UUID rejection, got %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := CanonicalBinding(testCourseID, testCreatedAt().In(time.FixedZone("UTC", 0))); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected UTC location rejection, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestProvisionReportsCreatedAndExactReplay(t *testing.T) {
	binding, err := CanonicalBinding(testCourseID, testCreatedAt())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store := &memoryStore{}
	created, err := Provision(context.Background(), store, testCourseID, testCreatedAt())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create: %v", err)
	}
	if created.Status != "created" || created.Binding != binding {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected create result: %#v", created)
	}
	replay, err := Provision(context.Background(), store, testCourseID, testCreatedAt())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replay: %v", err)
	}
	if replay.Status != "already_present" || replay.Binding != binding {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected replay result: %#v", replay)
	}
}

func TestProvisionPropagatesBindingConflict(t *testing.T) {
	store := &memoryStore{err: domain.ErrConflict}
	if _, err := Provision(context.Background(), store, testCourseID, testCreatedAt()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestProvisionRejectsStoreResultThatDoesNotExactlyMatchCanonicalBinding(t *testing.T) {
	other, err := CanonicalBinding("22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", testCreatedAt())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store := &memoryStore{binding: other, exists: true}
	if _, err := Provision(context.Background(), store, testCourseID, testCreatedAt()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

type memoryStore struct {
	binding domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding
	exists  bool
	err     error
}

func (store *memoryStore) ProvisionDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(_ context.Context, wanted domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, bool, error) {
	if store.err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, store.err
	}
	if !store.exists {
		store.binding = wanted
		store.exists = true
		return wanted, true, nil
	}
	return store.binding, false, nil
}
